title: gatecall: what may leave the company, and where it may go
description: gatecall is a Claude Code plugin that keeps a company's data on its routes. Its hooks stop a message, a command, a web request or a tool call that carries an API key or token, a payment card number (Luhn-checked), an IBAN (ISO 13616 mod-97), a national ID number with its check digit, or a list of people's e-mail addresses or phone numbers, and say why in the person's language. Red folders are read only by a model on the company's own computer. Profiles cover any company, the EU and US defence contractors (no DeepSeek model, API or weights); program rules keep other AI agents (kimi, grok, agy) to training folders, cleaned copies and no blanket permissions. It writes a permissions.deny block with absolute paths and keeps a journal of kinds and rules that holds each stopped value only as a fingerprint under the company's own key (HMAC-SHA256) or as a count, with a retention period and an export. Python standard library only, no network.
